Title: European Union vehicle type
Description: The type of vehicle specified in eForms.

Title: European Union Clean Vehicle Directive vehicle category
Description: The category of vehicle falling within the scope of the EU Clean Vehicles Directive 2009/33/EC.

Title: European Union Clean Vehicle Directive contract type
Description: The category of contract according to the EU Clean Vehicles Directive 2009/33/EC.

Title: European Union Energy Efficiency Directive basis
Description: The legal framework that applies to a product, service, work or building within the scope of the EU Energy Efficiency Directive (EU) 2023/1791, like the Energy Label or Ecodesign rules.

Title: European Union Energy Efficiency Directive item
Description: The kind of product, service, work or building within the scope of the EU Energy Efficiency Directive (EU) 2023/1791.

Title: European Union energy efficiency label
Description: The energy efficiency class of a product, according to its EU energy label.
